spec.name: sprint45_taker_imbalance_tail_liquidity_altbasket
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 30m-smoothed taker-buy imbalance (z>2.5 over 1440m) predicts 30m continuation in tail-liquidity alts, where order-flow information is absorbed slowly (Liu-Tsyvinski; EFMA 2025). Majors and liquid alts are untested for this signal in the sprint, so this cell is the untested one, not a retread of closed volspike/breakout/qhour cells.
spec.power_argument: Tail-liquidity basket realized 4413 validation trades in sprint26 under identical caps, so n>=300 is near-certain. 30m dispersion ~60bp std assumed from the sprint26 artifact (to be re-checked): SE at n=1000 is ~1.9bp, min detectable edge at t=2 ~3.8bp, below the ~26bp T2 cost floor, so PASS needs gross above ~30bp. The null can fail: C0 gives net ~-26bp.
